title: I Upgraded Bishops to BEAT Stockfish
summary: Tony's bishops become Wizards vs Fairy-Stockfish. A wizard moves, captures and jumps up to three squares in any diagonal direction (so Wf1-c4 is possible on move 1, over the e2 pawn). He develops normally, gets outplayed, and loses to a sacrificial mating attack on g2 (~10:56).
rules: Wizard: moves/captures 1-3 squares along any diagonal and may jump over pieces in between (transcript: 'moves, captures, and jumps three squares in any diagonal direction'; whether it can stop at 1-2 squares is inferred from frame move dots).
